decision.reason: [ev-33ed09b97087] is just a one-line release-note title saying beta trace was added for namespaced resources. It doesn't say what the trace is (a CLI command, a feature gate or something else), whether it is opt-in, or whether existing behaviour changes. The proposed 'none' consequence relies on an opt-in condition ('environments that do not explicitly enable or use this tracing') that the evidence never states. To decide, we need the PR #6549 description or the docs showing what changed and whether anything existing works differently.
